name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) at hard priority matches the task's if-then order: reaching the exit must come after a toggle. Reaching the exit is only the condition of the 'if', so no Existence is owed, and the rule-only machine with no final state is correct.

texts: If at_exit occurs, switch_toggled must have occurred first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
